headline: Heat persists in Ahmedabad and Mumbai, while monsoon withdrawal affects northern cities
on_air: Good evening, viewers. Today, we see a mix of clear skies and overcast conditions across India. The heat is particularly intense in Ahmedabad and Mumbai, with temperatures expected to remain high tomorrow. In Ahmedabad, the temperature will peak at 35.8°C, while in Mumbai, it will hit 36.6°C. Monsoon withdrawal is affecting northern cities like Lucknow and Jaipur, leading to cooler temperatures. Lucknow will see a maximum of 31.2°C, down from 31.6°C today. In Jaipur, the temperature will drop to 31.3°C from 32.2°C. The air over Ahmedabad is heading towards Mumbai, with the system expected to reach Pune in 24 hours, with high confidence. The winds are steady and strong, at 8.4 km/h. In the south, Chennai and Bengaluru will remain overcast, with temperatures cooling slightly. Tomorrow, we'll see a mix of clear and overcast skies, with the monsoon's influence gradually waning. Stay tuned for updates. Back to you.
